def minPath(grid, k):
    n = len(grid)
    # Find the minimum value among the neighbors of the topâleft cell (0,0)
    neighbors = []
    if n > 1:
        neighbors.append(grid[0][1])   # right
        neighbors.append(grid[1][0])   # down
    # If the grid is 1x1, there are no neighbors; default to the cell itself
    min_neighbor = min(neighbors) if neighbors else grid[0][0]

    # Build the answer alternating 1 and the minimum neighbor value
    ans = []
    for i in range(k):
        ans.append(1 if i % 2 == 0 else min_neighbor)
    return ans
